name: Saheb Chatterjee
bio: Shaheb Chatterjee, also known as Shaheb Chattopadhyay, is a Bengali Indian male actor and singer of Tollywood Bangla and Bengali television. He is an alumnus of Dakshinee, the Rabindrasangeet institution of Kolkata. He is noted for his acting and singing, especially in Tagore songs or Rabindra Sangeet, and various cinemas of Tollywood Bangla. He appears in the Bengali TV serial Goyenda Ginni, which aired on Zee Bangla, as the husband of the protagonist Parama Mitra, Dr. Porimal Mitra, and as singer Sujon Kumar, in the serial Potol Kumar Ganwala, which is broadcast on Star Jalsha. He appeared as the king of Bhawal, O Tar Sannashi Rani, in the Bengali TV show, Sanyashi Raja, also broadcast on Star Jalsha. He participated in the reality show Dadagiri on December 30, 2017.
